PART I

Item 4. Information on the Company

A. History and Development of the Company

The Company was incorporated in 1987 under the laws of Taiwan as a specialist contract manufacturer.

B. Business Overview

The Company is the world's largest dedicated semiconductor foundry, manufacturing chips designed by its customers for use in smartphones, high-performance computing, automotive and other devices.

We also provide a comprehensive set of design ecosystem services.

C. Organizational Structure

The Company is organized through a group of wholly owned subsidiaries.
